import os, numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
os.chdir('/home/data4/xiangyu/BioDSA/workdir')
smiles='CC1OC12C1CC2(O)C1'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles))
if m.GetNumConformers()==0:
    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=20260308, useRandomCoords=True)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=1000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
atoms=[]
for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
    atoms.append((a.GetSymbol(),(p.x,p.y,p.z)))
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms, charge=0, spin=0, basis='def2-svp', unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
for xc in ['b3lyp']:
    mf=dft.RKS(mol)
    mf.xc=xc
    mf.conv_tol=1e-10
    mf.max_cycle=100
    e=mf.kernel()
    occ=mf.mo_occ
    homo=float(np.max(mf.mo_energy[occ>0]))
    lumo=float(np.min(mf.mo_energy[occ==0]))
    print('structure:',smiles)
    print('method: B3LYP/def2-SVP, MMFF94-optimized geometry')
    print('SCF converged:',mf.converged)
    print('total energy (Ha):',f'{e:.12f}')
    print('HOMO (Ha):',f'{homo:.12f}')
    print('LUMO (Ha):',f'{lumo:.12f}')
    print('gap (Ha):',f'{lumo-homo:.12f}')
